gpt_profiles.description: Preferred for focused summaries, extraction, translation, routine documents and small verified changes. Subscription consumption is not inferred from API prices.
Preferred implementation worker for Rust/Slint, Java, debugging, multi-file changes, tool workflows and professional work. Start at a sufficient moderate effort.
Use for difficult ambiguous problems, conflicting evidence, cross-system invariants and proven implementation failures. Do not select merely because it is the largest model.
Compatibility or availability alternative to GPT-6.1 Sol; prefer only when pinned, locally validated as better, or the modern Sol candidate is unavailable.
GPT-5.6 compatibility candidate for focused routine work; use when explicitly required or newer Luna is unavailable.
Balanced legacy GPT-5.6 candidate for a verified Terra workflow or when Sol is unavailable. The name Terra does not imply lower cost than GPT-6.1 Sol.
Legacy GPT-5.6 implementation candidate for explicit compatibility or unavailable newer Sol models.

free_profiles.description: Experimental free candidate for self-contained code suggestions and test drafts. This reference worker returns text and does not execute local tools. Local quality is not benchmarked.
Experimental free text candidate for public, reversible, self-contained work; not a measured replacement for a GPT tier.
Experimental free candidate for simple public text transformations. This reference adapter sends text only.
Experimental free candidate for bounded public text tasks; retain only if task acceptance and measured latency are adequate.
Catalogued vision candidate for a future image-aware worker. Disabled: this release does not transport images.
Optional random free-model router. Disabled by default because its actual model varies; enable only for experiments and record response.model.

routing.note: auto/luna require successful online Luna; local only via explicit --offline/--routing local. Missing key is an error. Fixed metadata only by default.
